story.title: OnTrac posts four rate and surcharge PDFs on its surcharges and rates page
story.sum: OnTrac's own Surcharges and rates page now lists four newly posted PDF files covering rates, AHS and LPS rates, and area surcharge ZIP codes.
story.plain: OnTrac added four file links to its Surcharges and rates page. They are a 2026 rates guide, a 2026 AHS and LPS rates document, an area surcharge ZIP code list, and a 2024 rates guide. The change record shows only the file names, so the rates, surcharge amounts and effective dates inside the documents are not known from this change.
story.src: OnTrac Surcharges and rates (spotted by Parcel Pigeon)
